items.title: George Williams Interview, 1959-03-17
items.q: went with Joyce McCoy, went with Joyce McCullen

ctx.x: Yeah. I guess she started the phone.

So, Morgan, Sam Morgan's come by every night. He said, boy you're going to be a good drummer someday. He said, now you should show me how to put that left foot and right foot down and keep the time with the music. So after a while, Morgan needed a drummer. Well he'd take me to the boy, just like I tell you, the boy Roy was playing with Sam Morgan. That told me to go with Chris Kelly. You heard talk of him? Oh yeah. I worked with Chris Kelly for many years at the Bulls Club. That's where we started, the Bulls…
You had a brass band too, didn't you?
